issue_request: FHIR-15599 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request to accept the ServiceRequest-specific changes in column H of the workflow-pattern spreadsheet, as the ServiceRequest child of the broader GF#14450/FHIR-14450 OO workflow report.
initial_application: The application trail is in old spreadsheet-era commits: f35985eb66 and 5617cb18f0 applied GF#14450 workflow-report updates to ServiceRequest and neighboring OO resources, and eb9d0942c0 explicitly mentioned GF#15599/GF#14450 while changing the ServiceRequest spreadsheet and introduction. Those spreadsheet sources were later refactored into current StructureDefinition XML and pattern QA files.
additional_context: FHIR-14450 confirms the parent workflow report was split into resource-specific child trackers including ServiceRequest GF#15599. Later workflow work continued through FHIR-19631 and the ServiceRequest-specific R6 ticket FHIR-43441, whose applied commit 696cf9c646 removed obsolete instantiates elements and added current Request mappings. source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as an active OO resource.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current authoritative ServiceRequest StructureDefinition declares Workflow Pattern and FiveWs mappings, maps the root and active elements to Request pattern elements, and uses current mapping exception and suppressed warning files for intentional divergences.
